title: Add section to member's edit user view with regard to his/her rights and how to enforce them (right to be forgotten)
body: To make it easy for members to view and possible make use of their rights as stated in the GDPR, do we want to make a section to the member's user view? Pro: it is easy for a member to see his/her rights and what steps to take. Con: it is easy for a member to see his/her rights and what steps to take, maybe resulting in more requests...?
author: Participant 1
scope: Current retrievable issue body and issue comments; not the original study's historical snapshot. Linked pages and attachments are not fetched.
